items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: An' they had Jimmy Rushing, me, Count Basie's band. So, I work around there for four...five years

ctx.x: heard me sing, he heard Jimmy Rushing sing. He used to go down to listen to Count Basie and listen to Jimmy Rushing. He'd come out there and listen to me and Pete Johnson, Ben Webster and all of us sing. So he said one of these days he gonna bring us to New York. 'Course, we didn't believe him, 'cause he was talent scout then, and he run around all over the country pickin' up entertainers, bringin' them to New York. So he did.

He took Count Basie's band first, and he wanted me to go with Count Basie's band and leave Jimmy Rushing but I wouldn't go because Jimmy Rushing had been working with Count Basie's band all along, and I was with Pete Johnson's band, so I tol' him I didn't want to go with Count Basie. I'll wait till he come back and he pick up my band.
